Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equities ended mixed on Thursday, with the Sensex slipping 22 points and the Nifty gaining 53 points amid sharp closing volatility. Mid- and small-cap stocks outperformed, driven by buying interest in sectors like capital goods, defence, power, and healthcare.

Markets.title: Sebi bars Kore Digital promoters over alleged Rs 541 crore revenue misstatement
Markets.summary: Sebi has barred Kore Digital and three key executives after finding prima facie evidence of financial misstatements and the alleged diversion of preferential issue proceeds. The regulator also blocked the company's migration to the main board and ordered a forensic audit of its records.

Markets.title: Fed builds credibility, but hawkish turn leaves investors edgy
Markets.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, signaling a hawkish shift in inflation management. This unanimous decision caused bond yields to retract after an initial surge, leaving investors bracing for potential future rate increases.

Markets.title: CoreWeave launches $3 billion convertible debt sale
Markets.summary: AI infrastructure provider CoreWeave is raising $3 billion through a convertible debt offering and an at-the-market stock sale. The capital will be used to strengthen the company's credit profile and support its ongoing operations.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks rise as oil prices ease pressure after Fed rate hike
Markets.summary: US stocks rose on Thursday as declining oil prices relieved market pressure following the Federal Reserve's recent interest rate hike. Technology stocks regained some previous losses while investors assessed future rate increase possibilities.

Markets.title: NSE enters India’s mega-IPO club: 2nd-largest issue, 2nd-highest anchor count with 189 investors
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange raised Rs 22,561.57 crore in its initial public offering, making it India's second-largest public issue behind Hyundai Motor India. The offering also secured the country's second-highest anchor investor count by attracting 189 investors who contributed Rs 6,746.18 crore before public subscription.

Geo-Political.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has welcomed a European Union proposal for Canada to become an associate member. He stated that this alliance between Canada and the EU would create a beacon for other democracies.

Geo-Political.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
Geo-Political.summary: South African police are investigating a string of deaths after the ninth woman's body was found. While authorities caution against assuming the killings are linked, many women in the area are afraid.

Geo-Political.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
Geo-Political.summary: UN experts state there are grounds to believe the United States committed war crimes during February strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd. The U.S. has not acknowledged carrying out these deadly attacks in Iran.

Geo-Political.title: Hyrox athlete apologises for continuing race after soiling herself
Geo-Political.summary: Hyrox athlete Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized for continuing to race after accidentally soiling herself during a fitness competition last week. She has also forfeited her victory in the event as a result of the incident.

Geo-Political.title: Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Sylvia Zin and other family members of individuals imprisoned in China are asking President Trump to raise their relatives' arrests during his upcoming meeting with China's leader. Zin's husband, a U.S. scholar, is among those currently jailed in China.

Geo-Political.title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation reveals that former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad approved the abduction of US journalist Austin Tice. The kidnapping was reportedly planned for weeks before it was executed.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author tested AI traffic generation by asking ChatGPT to recommend the best WordPress SaaS course. ChatGPT recommended the author's course as the top result without any paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools have become essential for digital creators looking to stay ahead in 2025. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to simplify and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The central government will host a conference with state finance ministers on October 7 to discuss financing India's development. This meeting precedes the upcoming GST Council meeting and the start of pre-budget consultations for the 2027-28 Union Budget.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi turns 76: Demonetisation, GST, PLI, Jan Dhan and more – Key economic policies rolled out since 2014
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has overseen major economic reforms, welfare expansion, and technological transformation since taking office in May 2014. Key policies implemented during his tenure include demonetisation, GST, the PLI scheme, and Jan Dhan.

Data & Insights.title: Exclusive | Big change soon in how people earn, invest as salaried white-collar jobs set to decline: Saurabh Mukherjea
Data & Insights.summary: Saurabh Mukherjea states that artificial intelligence will soon automate repetitive white-collar jobs and reshape the employment landscape. This shift will significantly change how people earn and invest, leading to a rise in gig work, particularly in India.

Data & Insights.title: India’s US Treasury purchases surge to $15.2 billion in July, highest holdings in 10 months
Data & Insights.summary: In July, India purchased $15.2 billion in US Treasuries, marking its highest holdings in 10 months. This record acquisition was driven by large capital inflows from the central bank's special facilities designed to attract overseas funds.

Data & Insights.title: India flags impact on ties, energy markets from US law on Russian oil imports
Data & Insights.summary: The US House passed a bipartisan bill giving the president power to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries like India and China for importing Russian energy. India warned this legislation could negatively impact bilateral relations and energy markets.

Data & Insights.title: In charts: How India’s Russian oil imports shifted amid US tariff flip-flops
Data & Insights.summary: India faces potential 100% US tariffs under new legislation targeting buyers of Russian energy. This development complicates India's ongoing efforts to diversify its energy security amid a surge in its reliance on Russian oil.

India.title: No Ganesh Idol Immersion In Water Bodies From 2027: Tamil Nadu To Green Court
India.summary: Tamil Nadu told the National Green Tribunal that the immersion of Ganesh idols in water bodies will be prohibited starting in 2027. The state provided this assurance during a hearing on a petition aimed at preventing environmental damage caused by the practice.

India.title: Anti-Pollution Crackdown Intensifies Across NCR, 150 Inspections In 15 Days
India.summary: Over a 15-day period, the Commission for Air Quality Management's Flying Squads conducted 150 targeted inspections across the National Capital Region. These inspections focused on industrial units, construction sites, and power-generation facilities as part of an intensified anti-pollution crackdown.

India.title: Punjab Ambedkar Statue Row: BJP's Vijay Sampla Injured In Clash With BSP Workers
India.summary: BJP leader Vijay Sampla was injured during a clash between BJP and BSP workers in Punjab. The violence erupted following an argument that began after alleged remarks were made against Sampla.

India.title: 17-Year-Old Girl Raped In Chhattisgarh, 4 Men Arrested: Cops
India.summary: Four men in Chhattisgarh were arrested for allegedly raping a 17-year-old girl. The victim had gone out with one of the accused, who took her to a village with three friends where the assault occurred.

India.title: 2 Dead In 2 Days During Clashes Over Ganesh Chaturthi Procession In Tamil Nadu
India.summary: Two people have died during clashes over a Ganesh Chaturthi procession in Tamil Nadu over a two-day period. The most recent violence occurred in the Cuddalore district villages of Keelkarapattu and Melkarapattu.

India.title: Exclusive: After Survey Flags 2,800% Pharma Profit, Tukaram Mundhe Calls For Transparency
India.summary: Official Tukaram Mundhe criticized the pharmaceutical industry's 2,800% trade margin following a survey highlighting the markup. He stated that such extreme profit margins are unacceptable for consumers, hospitals, and regulators, demanding greater transparency.

General.title: Remains found after wildfire identified as mother-of-three missing since 2019
General.summary: Police have identified the remains of Joanne Sheen, a mother-of-three missing since 2019, following a wildfire in London. A 56-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the case.

General.title: Interest rates held but Bank signals rise if energy prices stay high
General.summary: The Bank of England has kept interest rates on hold for the sixth consecutive time. However, the Bank warns that sustained high energy prices make a future rate increase more likely.

General.title: Father's tribute to 'sweetest little boy' Noah Woods
General.summary: Rhys Woods has paid tribute to his three-year-old son, Noah Woods, following the boy's death. He also expressed his deepest gratitude to the local community for their support.

General.title: King Charles warns of 'existential danger' of AI falling into wrong hands
General.summary: The comments were made at a summit in Scotland with participants from AI giants such as Nvidia, OpenAI and Anthropic.

General.title: Watch: Is Canada about to join the EU?
General.summary: Canada and the European Union are strengthening their relations as trade disputes with the United States persist. This growing partnership has sparked discussions about whether Canada might eventually join the EU.
